script:
NOCID=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOCID/bash/bash_events/search" --expect 404 \
  --check detail contains 'Conversation not found' --save F13.scoped-unknown/search
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOCID/bash/bash_events/00000000000000000000000000000000" --expect 404
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOCID/bash/bash_events/" --json '["x"]' --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOCID/bash/start_bash_command" \
  --json '{"command": "echo QA_F13_NOCONV"}' --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOCID/bash/execute_bash_command" \
  --json '{"command": "echo QA_F13_NOCONV"}' --expect 404 --save F13.scoped-unknown/execute
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOCID/bash/bash_events" --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOCID/bash/bash_commands/00000000000000000000000000000000/stop" --expect 404
